d.ko: In this latest chapter from the award-winning studio behind Batman - The Telltale Series, both Bruce Wayne and Batman will be forced into precarious new roles. The Riddler has returned to terrorize Gotham City, but his gruesome puzzles merely foreshadow an even greater crisis.

d.zh: 在屡获殊荣的Batman - The Telltale Series后，同一制片室又推出故事的最新一章。Bruce Wayne和Batman将被迫承接危险重重的新角色。Riddler重返被恐怖笼罩的Gotham市，但他可怕的谜题只是更大危机的前兆。
